INFO.name: QUERY
INFO.value: SELECT TOP 1000 designation,ra,pmra,dec,pmdec,ref_epoch,parallax,radial_velocity,phot_g_mean_mag,phot_bp_mean_mag,phot_rp_mean_mag,teff_gspphot,logg_gspphot ,DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), POINT('ICRS', 274.860625, 38.7505)) AS separation FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS', 274.86063, 38.75050, 0.08333))=1 and (phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL and ruwe < 1.4 and astrometric_excess_noise < 1) ORDER BY separation ASC
